component.name: FE-Xico Updater
component.summary: Keep FE-XicoOS up to date and recover with rollback

description.p: FE-Xico Updater is the system-maintenance utility of FE-XicoOS. It shows whether your system is current, checks for and prepares FE-XicoOS image updates through the native bootc services, and explains restart and rollback in plain language. It never restarts the computer by itself.
It works with keyboard, mouse, touch and game controllers.

ul.li: Rebranded application, package, desktop integration, and configuration paths for FE-Xico.
Retains Universal Blue uupd integration and existing update functionality.
